plan.title: Add global actions section to VSCode extension
plan.overview: Implement a new "Global Actions" TreeView section in the VSCode sidebar that provides quick access to kanban-map-product and kanban-map-engineering commands. The view follows the existing config-view.capability.ts pattern with a simple factory function returning TreeDataProvider. Actions execute via terminal capability using the established claude "/kanban-{command}" pattern.

approach.rationale:
Following two existing patterns: - Capability factory: createConfigViewCapability at config-view.capability.ts:46-76 provides the minimal pattern for static TreeViews with factory returning createTreeDataProvider - Terminal execution: extension.ts:249-251 shows the pattern for running claude commands via terminal.createFreshTerminal, showTerminal, sendCommand
The Global Actions view is intentionally simple: - No file watching needed (actions are static) - No computer layer needed (no data transformation) - Single capability with two TreeItem classes (group + action)
ThemeIcons: "book" for Map Product Docs (matches update-docs column), "symbol-structure" for Map Engineering Docs (represents system architecture).

task.name: Manual verification
task.requirements: FR1, FR2, FR3, FR4, FR5, FR6, FR7
task.action: 1. Install extension locally: npm run local --prefix apps/vscode 2. Open VSCode in a workspace with .kanban/ folder 3. Verify sidebar shows "GLOBAL ACTIONS" section below "CONFIG" 4. Verify "Global Actions" group is expanded by default 5. Verify two action items visible: "Map Product Docs" and "Map Engineering Docs" 6. Verify icons: book icon for Product, symbol-structure for Engineering 7. Click "Map Product Docs" - verify terminal opens with claude "/kanban-map-product" 8. Click "Map Engineering Docs" - verify terminal opens with claude "/kanban-map-engineering" 9. Verify keyboard navigation: Tab to action, Enter to activate
task.done: All 5 acceptance criteria from task verified

testing.automated: None required - simple static view with no business logic, manual verification sufficient
testing.manual: - Global Actions section visible in sidebar below Config - Group expanded by default showing two actions - Correct ThemeIcons displayed (book, symbol-structure) - Clicking Map Product Docs opens terminal with correct command - Clicking Map Engineering Docs opens terminal with correct command - Keyboard navigation works (native TreeView behavior)
testing.regression: - Tasks view still works correctly - Config view still works correctly - Existing terminal commands still work

edge-cases.case: Global Actions view hidden (inherits kanban.hasKanbanFolder context from existing views)
Group stays collapsed (native TreeView behavior persists state)
createFreshTerminal creates new terminal instance per action (existing pattern)

pitfalls.pitfall: Must use claude "/kanban-{command}" format with quotes and leading slash - matches existing patterns at extension.ts:251, 270, 285
Array order determines sidebar order - kanbanGlobalActions must be last to appear below Config
Do NOT import terminal.capability.ts - terminal is passed via orchestrator (extension.ts)
